title: He Came to Earth Who Came from God
description: He Came to Earth Who Came from God in Tonic Solfa to HOLY MATRIMONY, doh is G: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 3 verses and a piano.
about: John Brownlie translated these words from the Greek service books for Hymns from the Greek Office Books (Paisley, 1904).
The book printed the words without tunes. They are in Common Particular Metre (8.8.6.8.8.6), and this page sets them to HOLY MATRIMONY; any other Common Particular Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: He came to earth who came from God, And left in heaven His blest a-bode, And all the joy He had; To share our lot, and all its woe, And wan-der home-less here be-low, All sor-row-ing and sad.

lines: He came to earth who came from God,
And left in heaven His blest abode,
And all the joy He had;
To share our lot, and all its woe,
He came to earth who came from God,
And ah! our rugged paths He trod,
And faint, and tired, and lone,
He bore the burden of our guilt,
And on a Cross His blood was spilt
He went to God who came to earth;
Now sing the new creation's birth,
For death is dead, and He who lives,

source: John Brownlie, Hymns from the Greek Office Books (1904)
licence: Public domain: John Brownlie died in 1925.
credits: Translated by John Brownlie (1857–1925) from the Greek, public domain, as printed in Hymns from the Greek Office Books; set to HOLY MATRIMONY by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
